sources.title: jasonjimnz/tyness-boe-1.2b-pre-alpha · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This is a pre-alpha release: it proves the full pipeline (dataset → QLoRA SFT on a GTX 1060 6GB → merge → GGUF → evaluation) and documents honest findings, including negative ones.

sources.title: jasonjimnz/tyness-boe-1.2b-pre-alpha-2 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Second pre-alpha from Tyness Train, an agent-guided fine-tuning harness for small LLMs on low-VRAM GPUs. This model is RAG-style grounded: every prompt carries excerpts of the relevant norm, and the model is trained to answer only from that context.
